svg.title: Stage 1: Start with the same input rows
svg.desc: The sentence is already given. We are first updating bank, at position 7—not predicting the word bank. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
01 Start with the same input rows
The sentence is already given. We are first updating bank,
at position 7—not predicting the word bank.
Only the receiver row is highlighted; the input stays fixed.
E includes token embedding + position. In this toy,
the projections ignore position; the causal mask still applies.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 2: Bank makes a query
svg.desc: Transform bank’s current representation into a request. Its 3 numbers match the 3 coordinates of each key. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
Transform bank’s current representation into a request.
Its 3 numbers match the 3 coordinates of each key.
The query is a vector, not an English question.
This toy asks for setting clues; the numbers are hand-designed.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 3: Every token offers a matching key
svg.desc: Each source describes when it may be useful. Bank’s one query will be compared with all these keys. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
03 Every token offers a matching key
Each source describes when it may be useful.
Bank’s one query will be compared with all these keys.
A key helps determine how much attention a source receives.
It is not the information payload we will mix.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 4: Compare the query with every key
svg.desc: Multiply matching coordinates, then add. We get one raw score per source position. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
04 Compare the query with every key
We get one raw score per source position.
One match, worked out: bank’s query · river’s key
A large score is a strong match for this query.
It need not belong to bank itself.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 5: Scale the scores before softmax
svg.desc: There are dₖ = 3 matching coordinates. Divide by √3. Scaling controls score spread; it does not change their order. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
There are dₖ = 3 matching coordinates. Divide by √3.
Scaling controls score spread; it does not change their order.
The same positive divisor is used for every score.
dot-product variance is dₖ; after scaling it is 1.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 6: Bank cannot read the future
svg.desc: For receiver 7, source positions 8–10 are not allowed. Set their scores to −∞ before applying softmax. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
For receiver 7, source positions 8–10 are not allowed.
Set their scores to −∞ before applying softmax.
Causal means j ≤ i: earlier positions and the current position.
The future words are shown only to make the mask visible.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 7: Turn scores into mixing weights
svg.desc: Softmax acts across the source-token columns. Allowed weights sum to 1; masked positions get exactly 0. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
Softmax acts across the source-token columns.
Allowed weights sum to 1; masked positions get exactly 0.
These are attention weights over input positions.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 8: Values carry what each token sends
svg.desc: Project each source into a value vector. Values take a separate route: they do not set the scores. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
08 Values carry what each token sends
Project each source into a value vector.
Values take a separate route: they do not set the scores.
Keys describe matching; values carry the message to retrieve.
Here a key has 3 coordinates and a value has 2.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 9: Collect a message for this query
svg.desc: Multiply each value by its attention weight, then add. The result m₇ is a 2-number message specifically for bank. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
09 Collect a message for this query
Multiply each value by its attention weight, then add.
The result m₇ is a 2-number message specifically for bank.
m₇ · SUM OF ALL SEVEN ALLOWED CONTRIBUTIONS
The mixture lives in value space. It is not yet the updated
5-number representation, and it is not a predicted word.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 10: Map the message back to 5 coordinates
svg.desc: W_O maps the value-space message into representation space. Now Δe₇ has the right shape to be added to e₇. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
10 Map the message back to 5 coordinates
W_O maps the value-space message into representation space.
Now Δe₇ has the right shape to be added to e₇.
This output projection bridges the two coordinate spaces.
The 2-number mixture and 5-number update are different objects.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 11: Keep bank, and add its context update
svg.desc: The long bypass carries the original e₇ unchanged. Add Δe₇ to obtain the context-enriched representation e′₇. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 7, bank.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
11 Keep bank, and add its context update
The long bypass carries the original e₇ unchanged.
Add Δe₇ to obtain the context-enriched representation e′₇.
bank keeps its original representation and receives context.
This changes the representation of this occurrence of bank.
It does not overwrite the shared embedding table.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown

svg.title: Stage 12: Now switch to the last token: the
svg.desc: Run the same path again with receiver 10, the final the. Its updated representation predicts the token at position 11. Q and K create weights; V carries information. A separate residual path preserves the input representation. Receiver: 10, the.
svg.text: One input sequence · causal reads · one residual update
12 Now switch to the last token: the
Run the same path again with receiver 10, the final the.
Its updated representation predicts the token at position 11.
This softmax is over 20 vocabulary tokens, not 10 inputs.
All projections still read the original E in this layer.
The new query does not read the just-computed e′₇.
SELF: Q, K and V come from the same E. CAUSAL: receiver i reads only positions j ≤ i.
Hand-designed toy · decimals rounded · no FFN or normalization shown
